scope.primary_source_rule: Company-issued pages, company filings/press releases, official certification records, and official counterparty records only.
scope.research_method: Targeted web review of official/primary sources; claims are paraphrased and scoped to the source locator. No capacity, qualification, facility, or canonical equivalence is inferred.

guardrails.license_posture: Public official pages/documents are linked and paraphrased only; copyright and reuse rights remain with the publisher or certifying body. No bulk source text is reproduced.

tasks.task: Operating India power-electronics / variable-speed-drive manufacturing facility evidence

tasks.capacity_semantics: ABB reports a 2025 target to double production capacity and a later relative increase of about 25 percent; neither is an absolute effective-capacity denominator, yield, utilization, or qualified-output claim.
tasks.canonical_gap_closed: Operating local VSD production and product-scope evidence narrows the cap:power-electronics presence/production gap; current qualified throughput and domestic content remain UNKNOWN.

source_records.primary_source_basis: ABB-issued news-center release describing its own Peenya production line.
source_records.page_section_locator: Press release title and body, paragraphs beginning 'ABB India expands its manufacturing footprint...' and 'The new line will produce drives...'; captured web lines 29-46.
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public ABB corporate webpage; copyright retained by ABB; URL and paraphrase only.

entity_facility.facility: Peenya factory, Bengaluru; new VSD-module production line

product_process_scope: position/angle/torque control and programmable fastening on the line
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: ABB states that its new Peenya line expands Indian manufacturing of variable-speed-drive modules, produces 75–250 kW drives for industrial segments, and includes precision testing and automated production features.

reported_capacity.claim: ABB aims to double production capacity by 2025
reported_capacity.state: Company target; not current effective or qualified capacity

source_records.project_or_operating_state: OPERATING_PRODUCTION_LINE_REPORTED; release describes the line as opened/expanded and manufacturing locally.
caveats: The 2025 doubling statement is a target, not a measured output result.
No line yield, utilization, local-content share, customer qualification, or annual qualified throughput is provided.

source_records.primary_source_basis: ABB India filing identifies the release as issued by the company and describes the Peenya factory's own production expansion.
source_records.page_section_locator: PDF p.1 bullets and paragraphs; p.2 production-automation paragraphs, especially the sections stating localized VSD production and a relative 25 percent increase.
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public ABB India corporate filing; copyright retained by ABB; URL and paraphrase only.

entity_facility.address_or_locator: Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

product_process_scope: robotics and digital production monitoring for drive-component production
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: ABB reports localized VSD production at the Peenya drives factory, a new automated line, and a company-reported increase of about 25 percent in local VSD production capacity; the release also describes large-power-rating drives for named industrial sectors.

reported_capacity.claim: Local VSD production capacity increased by about 25 percent with the new line
reported_capacity.denominator: Prior local VSD production capacity is not stated
reported_capacity.state: Company-reported relative change; not an absolute effective/qualified capacity

source_records.project_or_operating_state: OPERATING_PRODUCTION_EXPANSION_REPORTED; source says the upgraded factory has two decades of drives production in India.
caveats: Relative capacity change has no absolute baseline, time-series output, yield, utilization, or product-class denominator.
Lead-time and automation statements do not establish qualified supply for every drive rating or application.

source_records.primary_source_basis: WEG describes its own India manufacturing site and a named project supply package.
source_records.page_section_locator: Article title, date 13/08/2024, and paragraphs beginning 'The complete package of motors will be manufactured...' and 'The scope of supply includes...'.
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public WEG corporate webpage; copyright retained by WEG; URL and paraphrase only.
product_process_scope: mills, pumps, crushers, ventilation, compressors and grinders
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: WEG states that the complete package for an Indian cement project would be manufactured at its Hosur facilities and identifies a 130-motor low-voltage package spanning 18.5–315 kW and IE3 efficiency.

reported_output_or_lot.interpretation: Named project supply lot, not annual or effective plant capacity

source_records.project_or_operating_state: OPERATING_MANUFACTURING_SITE_REPORTED; project supply statement supports product manufacture at Hosur, not a general capacity claim.
caveats: A project package and rating range do not establish all Hosur product classes, annual throughput, yield, utilization, or customer qualification.
The article is a company supply statement, not an independent production audit.

source_records.publisher: Bureau Veritas Certification Holding SAS – UK Branch; certificate for WEG Industries (India) Private Limited
source_records.source_type: Official certification record hosted in WEG document center
source_records.primary_source_basis: Bureau Veritas certificate identifies the audited WEG India organization, site address, ISO 9001 scope, issue date, and expiry.
source_records.page_section_locator: PDF pp.1–2, ISO 9001:2015 scope and 'HEAD OFFICE - HOSUR LV FACTORY' site table.
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public certification PDF; certification body and WEG retain rights; URL and scoped paraphrase only.

entity_facility.address_or_locator: Plot No. E-20 (North), SIPCOT Industrial Complex Phase II Expansion II, Mornapalli Village, Hosur 635109, Tamil Nadu, India

product_process_scope: induction electrical motors up to 500 kW
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: The ISO 9001 certificate places design, development, manufacturing, testing, repair/re-powering and related services for induction electrical motors up to 500 kW within the certified scope of WEG India's Hosur LV Factory.
source_records.project_or_operating_state: CERTIFIED_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM_SCOPE; certification supports an audited scope but does not measure current production output.
caveats: ISO 9001 scope is not evidence of annual capacity, utilization, yield, customer approval, or every motor grade being produced now.
The 500 kW value is a product rating boundary, not a throughput denominator.

source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public BEL corporate webpage; copyright retained by BEL; URL and paraphrase only. The test subdomain is recorded as the fetched official-site render.

entity_facility.facility: Export Manufacturing SBU-Bengaluru / Bengaluru electronics manufacturing capability

product_process_scope: military, industrial and medical grade products
embedded software and firmware for FPGA/DSP/microcontroller/SoC hardware
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: BEL states that its Bengaluru export manufacturing capability has dedicated engineering, production and test facilities for electronics design/manufacturing services, including embedded hardware/software engineering and PCB, cable, precision, electromechanical, coating and burn-in processes; it explicitly lists industrial-grade products.
source_records.project_or_operating_state: OPERATING_ELECTRONICS_MANUFACTURING_CAPABILITY_PAGE; the page describes available production/test facilities and services, without an output denominator.
caveats: The page does not provide product-specific annual output, yield, utilization, customer approvals, or facility-level qualification scope.
A service capability page does not prove every embedded/industrial product is currently produced at volume.

source_records.primary_source_basis: BEL's own unit directory identifies the Bangalore manufacturing unit, address, focus areas and strategic business units.
source_records.page_section_locator: Manufacturing Units – Bangalore Unit page: address, Focus Areas, Strategic Business Units, and Other Manufacturing Units sections.
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public BEL corporate webpage; copyright retained by BEL; URL and paraphrase only.
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: BEL's Bangalore Unit page identifies an active manufacturing unit at Jalahalli and lists electronics-heavy focus areas and an Export Manufacturing strategic business unit, including components, communications, radars, avionics and related systems.
source_records.project_or_operating_state: MANUFACTURING_UNIT_DIRECTORY_LISTING; unit and product-area identity are source-supported, but output state and qualification are not quantified.
caveats: Focus-area listing is not evidence of production volume or a specific embedded-electronics line.
No current capacity, yield, utilization, customer qualification, or process window is reported.

source_records.primary_source_basis: BEL describes its PDIC facility, dates, engineering/prototyping functions, infrastructure and embedded-systems domain.
source_records.page_section_locator: PDIC overview and 'PDIC technology domains' sections; facility history says established December 2014, new facility activity from October 2018 and formal inauguration 19 September 2019.
source_records.effective_date: 2019-09-19 facility inauguration; page also states new-facility activity from 2018-10
source_records.license_reuse_posture: Public BEL corporate webpage; copyright retained by BEL; URL and paraphrase only.
product_process_scope: electronics, mechanical, computer science, electrical and optics engineering
source_records.scoped_claim_paraphrase: BEL states that PDIC is a centralized operating design house supporting all units, with prototyping, testing and design-validation infrastructure; its domains include embedded systems and related electronics, and it generates manufacturing documentation for modules, products and subsystems.

reported_facility_scale.interpretation: Facility/staffing scale only; not manufacturing throughput

caveats: PDIC is an R&D/design/prototype facility; its existence does not prove production output or customer-qualified industrial electronics.
The 700+ figure describes housing capacity for engineers, not accepted units/year.
